examples.en: No, that would be a big risk. I will study in the evenings first.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Belakangan ini kamu tampak sangat bersemangat. Ada apa?
dialogue.en: You look so excited lately. What is going on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Aku sedang berpikir untuk mengganti karier. Aku ingin meninggalkan akuntansi dan menjadi desainer.
dialogue.en: I am thinking of changing careers. I want to leave accounting and become a designer.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Wah, perubahan besar! Apa yang membuatmu memutuskan itu?
dialogue.en: Wow, that is quite a change! What made you decide?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Aku sadar bahwa aku tidak lagi termotivasi, dan aku ingin pekerjaanku kreatif.
dialogue.en: I realized that I no longer feel motivated, and I want my work to be creative.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Apakah kamu akan langsung berhenti dari pekerjaan?
dialogue.en: Are you going to quit your job straight away?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tidak, itu risiko besar. Aku akan belajar di malam hari dulu.
dialogue.en: No, that would be a big risk. I will study in the evenings first.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Keterampilan apa yang perlu kamu pelajari?
dialogue.en: What skills do you need to learn?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Terutama perangkat lunak desain dan komunikasi, tetapi aku sudah punya kemampuan mengatur yang baik.
dialogue.en: Mainly design software and communication, but I already have good organizational skills.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Itu keuntungan. Apakah kamu kenal seseorang di bidang itu?
dialogue.en: That is an advantage. Do you know anyone in that field?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, mantan teman sekelasku sekarang jadi mentorku, dan dia memberiku masukan yang jujur.
dialogue.en: Yes, a former classmate is my mentor now, and she gives me honest feedback.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tidak terlalu. Aku menemukan kursus daring yang biayanya lebih murah daripada keanggotaan pusat kebugaran sebulan.
dialogue.en: Not too much. I found an online course that costs less than a monthly gym membership.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.en: And what does your family think about it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mereka khawatir, tetapi mereka mendukungku, asalkan aku punya rencana.
dialogue.en: They are worried, but they support me, as long as I have a plan.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Aku kagum pada keberanianmu. Banyak orang tidak pernah mengambil langkah pertama.
dialogue.en: I admire your courage. Many people never take the first step.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Terima kasih. Meskipun gagal, aku akan belajar sesuatu yang baru.
dialogue.en: Thank you. Even if it fails, I will have learned something new.
